name: Howdy, Pardner!
source:
Girls? Falling in love. Boys? Falling in wells.

"Howdy, Pardner!" is a short, sweet little wild-west themed dating sim. You are the mayor’s daughter, and when a gorgeous outlaw lady comes to rob your stagecoach, you concoct a plan with her to rob the town bank and free yourself from Crimestead and flee to Pride Canyon. 

[From [url=https://zenithzyie.itch.io/howdy-pardner]itch.io[/url]]
